_what: HAND-WRITTEN AS3 rule for each case. The AIR arm is checked against this file, so 'AIR is the reference' is itself measured. Values are the text after the last '=' of a Cases.one(id) line.
_rule: In AS3 a Number / String / Boolean / Array is a legal value of an `Object`-typed variable, and `is` answers about the VALUE, not the slot's static type. Only case 10 (a genuine Marker instance) is true for `is Marker`.
_knownAotDeviations_note: EMPTY since 阶段二百五十三 (v0.4.217) -- the compiler now answers all 26 cells exactly like AIR. The eight former deviations were: 1 = "is Array" constant-folded to false; 3/12/19/21/26 = "as_is(<array ptr>, &SomeClass_vt)" read the array header's first word as a vtable -> SIGSEGV; 15 = "as Array" -> NULL; 16 = "length" -> undefined. FIX (src/emit.ts + src/runtime.ts): an Object-typed receiver now takes the SAME runtime dispatch a "*" receiver already took (as_obj_is_array / as_obj_as_array / as_obj_class_of for is+as+constructor, as_dyn_call -> as_arr_call for methods, as_dyn_get -> as_array_key_get for index/length, as_dyn_del for delete, as_obj_to_str / as_obj_to_number for String()/Number(), as_obj_to_value for for-each), and as_is / as_iface_lookup refuse to read a first word that is not a vtable (as_has_vtable).
